annotations.title: Request a news refresh for a player

description: Queues an on-demand news pull for a player who has no news coverage yet and returns at once (202); the headlines appear in get_player_news shortly after. Use it only when get_player_news comes back empty. Asking twice is harmless. Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
